title: Small Language Models as Judges for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.30005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning extends RL beyond tasks with exact answers or rule-based verifiers by scoring responses against instance-specific criteria. However, this makes reward computation expensive: training requires repeated rubric judging, often with proprietary APIs or local generative LLM judges with 7B parameters or more. We study whether smaller language models can serve as efficient and reliable rubric-based judges. To make this question measurable, we construct PointRubric and RaR-Science-Static, two pointwise rubric-based evaluation datasets with instance-specific criteria and itemwise satisfaction labels. We compare three ways of extracting criterion-level judgments from small models: Generative verdicts, Yes/No Logprob margins, and Probe judges. translated_title: 小型语言模型作为基于量规的强化学习评判器
translated_abstract: 基于量规的强化学习通过针对特定实例的标准对模型响应进行评分，将强化学习扩展到了超出具有精确答案或基于规则验证器的任务范围。然而，这使得奖励计算变得昂贵：训练需要反复进行量规评判，通常依赖专有API或参数量在70亿及以上的本地生成式大语言模型评判器。我们研究了更小的语言模型是否能作为高效且可靠的基于量规的评判器。为了使这一问题可被衡量，我们构建了PointRubric和RaR-Science-Static两个基于逐点评定量规的评估数据集，其中包含特定实例的评分标准及逐项满足标签。我们比较了从小模型中提取标准级评判的三种方法：生成式判定、是/否对数概率边际以及探针评判器。在两个数据集上，Qwen3-1.7B探针评判器在这些方法中取得了最强的标准级一致性，优于生成式评判器和对数概率评判器。
tldr: 该研究通过构建两个量规评估数据集并对比三种评判方法，证明了仅1.7B参数的小型语言模型（采用探针评判方法）可作为高效可靠的量规评判器，从而大幅降低基于量规的强化学习中奖励计算的成本。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates that a 1.7B-parameter small language model, when used as a probe judge, can serve as an efficient and reliable rubric-based judge, significantly reducing the cost of reward computation in rubric-based reinforcement learning.
